from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """A single paper in the collection, identifying itself and what other provided papers it references."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The exact title of this paper")
    references: list[str] | None = Field(description="Titles of other provided papers that appear in this paper's reference list (bibliography)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
